correctness.rationale: For s>=2, n=(2^(2s)+1)(2^s-1), both cases of Wang--He--Yi--Zheng Lemma 6 supply a five-element support in one residue class mod r_s=n/5 or n/51. Since the BCH code is cyclic, its shifts by t=0,..,r_s-1 are all codewords with disjoint supports. They generate [5,1,5]_2 direct summands, hence W_R=(1+z^5)^r_s, A_5j(C)>=binom(r_s,j) and d_j(C)<=5j. Over GF(2), the two root sum identities were checked independently, including polynomial divisibility for the order-51 pattern and 58 finite arithmetical cases; infinite divisibility is algebraic. The code family, precise normalization and ambient lower bounds are mathematically sound.
